item.title: Woodream Akiya 200
item.excerpt:
A floating pencil bait inspired by sardines called tuba in Sagami Bay. A timeless body, durability as fishing gear, and hidden possibilities. Professional tools may be difficult. However, professional tools can become the ultimate tool depending on the angler, and have the potential to respond to the user’s intentions.

A project started with genuine fish lovers in search of fishing results. When the dna of a fisherman and the soul of an angler are fused, Akiya becomes an evolved lure. We are particular about handmade in japan, just as japanese fishermen individually create original items with their own hands.

  • Length 200 mm

  • Gr. 97

prevItem.title: Indigo Blue Musya Pop
prevItem.excerpt:
Indigo Blue lures have been hand crafting lures in Japan for around 20 years and are built from tung tree wood. To ensure swimming perfection, each lure under goes an individual swim test before being released. With a strictly limited number of boutique lures produced each year, they are highly prised and sought after in Japan perfect for targeting a wide range of pelagic species.

A handmade popper suitable for kingfish, tuna and GT by the respectable Satoshi-san at Indigo Blue Japan. A popper that achieves seamless casting distance to target fish from a distance with a stabilised flight motion during the cast due the shape of the lure and material of the body. 

The Musyapop will respond well to long sweep, a short sweep and a high speed retrieve. 

  • Length 210 - Gr. 100

  • Length 240 - Gr. 125
